description: US industry breadth from the ISM Report On Business rankings: which of ISM's 18 manufacturing or 18 services industries reported growth (strongest first) or contraction (steepest first) each month, overall and for new orders, production/business activity, employment and prices. Rank signal +1 (strongest growth) to -1 (steepest contraction), 0 = no change reported. Derived breadth measure, not an index level.
name: get_us_industries
